study_title: Organizational Communication Resilience Under Key-Actor Loss
design: Secondary observational network stress test of the Enron temporal email hypergraph
projection_note: Each email hyperedge is projected to all unique undirected pairwise co-participation ties. Repeated event members are deduplicated and repeated ties are collapsed in the released simple graph.
primary_metric: Global efficiency among surviving nodes, normalized by intact-network global efficiency.
targeting_rule: Static degree ranking computed once on the intact projection.

random_comparator.quantile_note: p05 and p95 are released empirical order-statistic diagnostics from sorted random draws.

license_note: Zenodo marks the record as Open, but the displayed Rights section does not show a specific license value. This repository therefore does not redistribute the raw dataset; users should follow the Zenodo record and original-source terms.
claim_boundary: Email connectivity is a proxy for potential structural information access, not direct evidence of tacit knowledge, expertise, employee value, learning effectiveness, or causal organizational performance. The historical Enron setting also limits external validity.
